notes.title: Version 1.3 Released!
notes.content:
We’ve fixed bugs, refined scenes, created additional animations, and even added some underwater interactivity. Nothing especially obvious, just details to polish your experience a bit.

If you have questions, worries, or high fives, send ‘em our way! support@brainandbrain.co

- David & Brooke

notes.title: Achievements! Italian! SALE?!
notes.content:
Ever since our beardy fellas received that honorable mention for IGF's Excellence in Narrative award, they've been clamoring for some way to keep track of their achievements. And something about a quit button. Fine.

Today's update adds the following:

    Achievements
    Italian localization
    Steam Controller config
    Steam Cloud support
    Quit button
    Bug fixes and polish


AND for the first time, Burly Men at Sea is 30% off!

*chaos of celebration*

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021311/88935249cfaacdcfc6c0ec2c2326d510d10de29d.gif
